description: The team's position in its league table.
interpretation: League position - 1 = top of the table

description: Points the team won: 3 for a win, 1 for a draw, none for a defeat.
numerator_expr: sum(case result when 'W' then 3 when 'D' then 1 else 0 end)
interpretation: Points tally in the window (3 per win / 1 per draw / 0 per loss)

description: Average number of goals the team scored per match.
interpretation: Attacking output - goals scored per game; high = a potent attack

description: Average number of goals the team conceded per match.
interpretation: Defensive vulnerability - goals conceded per game; low = a mean defence

description: Matches in which the team conceded no goal, as a share of all its matches.
interpretation: Shut-out rate - the share of matches conceding zero; high = reliable at the back

description: Goals the team scored from penalties, not counting penalty shoot-outs.
interpretation: Penalty goals - goals from the spot; they count toward the result and often reward pressure that wins fouls

description: Own goals by the team's opponents, which count for the team.
interpretation: Own goals for - goals from opponents' own nets in the team's favour; they count toward the result and are often pressure-forced

description: Goals the team scored, not counting penalties and opponents' own goals.
interpretation: Open-play goals - goals from open play (excl. penalties and own goals); the core attacking output

description: Average number of shots the team took per match.
interpretation: Shot volume - attacking attempts per game; high = more attacking threat (volume not shot quality)

description: The team's shots on target as a share of all its shots.
interpretation: Striking precision - share of shots on goal

description: The team's shots from inside the penalty area as a share of all its shots.
interpretation: Chance quality - share of shots from inside the box; high = better positions

description: Average number of shots on target the team had per match.
interpretation: On-target threat - efforts testing the keeper; high = sustained threat

description: Goals the team scored, not counting penalties and opponents' own goals, as a share of its shots on target.
interpretation: Clinical finishing - open-play goals per shot on goal; high = ruthless

description: Goals the player scored, not counting penalties, as a share of the player's shots on target.
interpretation: Clinical finishing - open-play goals per shot on target; high = a ruthless finisher

description: Average number of one-on-one challenges for the ball, on the ground or in the air, that the team's players contested per match.
interpretation: Duel engagement - duels contested per game; high = a physically engaged side (volume; can also reflect a side under sustained pressure)

description: One-on-one challenges for the ball, on the ground or in the air, that the team's players won, as a share of those they contested.
interpretation: Duel success - share of duels won; high = wins the physical battle

description: One-on-one challenges for the ball, on the ground or in the air, that the player won, as a share of those the player contested.
interpretation: Duel success - share of 1v1 contests won; high = wins the physical battle

description: Average number of tackles, interceptions and blocks the team's players made per match.
interpretation: Defensive activity - tackles + interceptions + blocks per game; high = an active ball-winning defence (volume; can also reflect a side often defending)

description: Average number of tackles the team's players made per match.
interpretation: Tackling volume - more ball-winning challenges per game is better all else equal; high can also reflect a side that defends more

description: Average number of opponents' passes the team's players intercepted per match.
interpretation: Interception volume - more passes read and cut out per game is better all else equal; high can also reflect a side that defends more

description: Average number of shots the team's players blocked per match.
interpretation: Block volume - more shots blocked per game is better all else equal; high can also reflect a side under sustained pressure

description: Average number of passes the team attempted per match.
interpretation: Possession volume - passes played per game; high = sees more of the ball; low = a more direct style (accuracy shows how securely it is kept)

description: The team's passes that reached a teammate, as a share of all its passes.
interpretation: Passing security - completion rate; high = keeps the ball well

description: Average number of passes per match by the team's players that led directly to a teammate's shot.
interpretation: Creativity - passes leading to a shot; high = creates chances

description: Average number of corner kicks the team won per match.
interpretation: Corners won - high = sustained attacking pressure (a weak proxy)

description: Average number of corner kicks the team conceded per match.
interpretation: Corners conceded - low = less defensive pressure faced (a weak proxy)

description: The team's saves as a share of its saves plus the goals it conceded, own goals not counted.
interpretation: Shot-stopping - share of on-target shots saved; high = strong keeping

description: Goals the player scored, penalties included and own goals not.
interpretation: Scoring output - goals scored in the window; high = a productive goalscorer (a raw count so it also tracks minutes played)

description: Goals the player set up for a teammate.
interpretation: Creative output - goals set up in the window; high = a productive creator (a raw count so it also tracks minutes played)

description: Goals the player scored from penalties, not counting penalty shoot-outs.
interpretation: Penalty goals - goals from the spot; they count toward the result and reward taking and converting penalties

description: Goals the player scored, not counting penalties.
interpretation: Open-play goals - goals from open play (excl. penalties); the player's core attacking output

description: Penalties awarded for fouls on the player.
interpretation: Penalties won - spot kicks earned in the window; high = draws fouls in dangerous areas (rare enough that small differences mean little)

description: Shots on target the player had.
interpretation: On-target threat - efforts that tested the keeper; high = a persistent goal threat (a raw count so it also tracks minutes played)

description: One-on-one challenges for the ball, on the ground or in the air, that the player won.
interpretation: Duels won - physical 1v1 contests won in the window; high = comes out on top in physical battles (a volume read; the duel win rate captures efficiency)

description: One-on-one challenges for the ball, on the ground or in the air, that the player contested.
interpretation: Duel engagement - 1v1 contests entered in the window; high = a physically involved player (a volume read; can also reflect a side under pressure)

description: Dribbles in which the player got past an opponent.
interpretation: Take-ons completed - opponents beaten on the dribble; high = a dangerous ball-carrier (a volume read; the success rate captures reliability)

description: Times the player tried to dribble past an opponent.
interpretation: Take-ons attempted - times the player ran at an opponent; high = willing to take players on (a volume read; the success rate shows how often it comes off)

description: Dribbles in which the player got past an opponent, as a share of the player's attempts to dribble past one.
interpretation: Share of take-ons completed; high = a reliable dribbler.

description: Tackles the player made.
interpretation: Tackling volume - challenges won in the window; high = an active ball-winner (also reflects how much the side has to defend)

description: Opponents' passes the player intercepted.
interpretation: Interception volume - passes read and cut out; high = anticipates play well (also reflects how much the side has to defend)

description: Shots the player blocked.
interpretation: Block volume - shots blocked in the window; high = throws the body in (often for a side under sustained pressure)

description: Times an opponent dribbled past the player.
interpretation: Times beaten - dribbled past by an opponent; low = hard to get past (a raw count so it also tracks how often the player is the one defending)

description: The player's passes that reached a teammate.
interpretation: Completed passes - passes that found a team-mate; high = heavily involved in possession (a volume read; the completion rate captures security)

description: Passes the player attempted.
interpretation: Passing volume - passes attempted in the window; high = a possession-anchoring role; low = a more direct or less involved one (a raw count so it also tracks minutes played)

description: The player's passes that reached a teammate, as a share of all the player's passes.
interpretation: Share of passes completed; high = a secure and reliable passer.

description: The player's passes that led directly to a teammate's shot.
interpretation: Chance creation - passes leading directly to a shot; high = a creative hub (a raw count so it also tracks minutes played)

description: Yellow cards the player received.
interpretation: Cautions - yellow cards shown in the window; low = stays on the right side of the referee (high can reflect an aggressive role as much as poor discipline)

description: Red cards the player received.
interpretation: Dismissals - red cards shown in the window; low = avoids leaving the team a man short (rare enough that a single card dominates the count)

description: Times the player was caught offside.
interpretation: Offside calls - times caught beyond the last defender; low = better timed runs (high can reflect a striker who plays the shoulder rather than poor movement)

description: Penalties the player gave away.
interpretation: Penalties conceded - fouls given in the team's own box; low = defends cleanly in dangerous areas (rare enough that small differences mean little)

description: Shots on target the player saved in goal.
interpretation: Save volume - shots on goal kept out; high = a busy keeper facing plenty of work (volume also tracks shots faced so it is not shot-stopping quality; the save rate captures that)

description: Shots on target the player faced in goal: the player's saves plus the goals conceded while the player was in goal.
interpretation: On-target shots faced - efforts the keeper had to deal with; low = a well-protected goal (a workload read; it says more about the defence than the keeper)

description: The player's saves as a share of the player's saves plus the goals conceded while the player was in goal.
interpretation: Share of shots on goal saved; high = a strong shot-stopper.

description: Shots the player took.
interpretation: Shot volume - attempts on and off target; high = shoots often (volume not shot quality; a raw count so it also tracks minutes played)

description: Goals the team conceded while the player was in goal.
interpretation: Goals conceded - goals let in while the player was on the pitch; low = kept the goal intact (a team outcome; it reflects the defence as much as the individual)

description: The team's shots as a share of all shots in its matches.
interpretation: Shooting dominance - share of the match's shots; high = controls the chances (deserved-vs-actual input)

description: Points the team won as a share of the 3 points per match it could have won.
numerator_expr: sum(case result when 'W' then 3 when 'D' then 1 else 0 end)
interpretation: Results efficiency - share of available points won (deserved-vs-actual input)

description: The player's goals plus assists.
interpretation: Goal involvement - goals plus assists in the window; high = directly decisive in front of goal (a raw count so it also tracks minutes played)

description: Tackles, interceptions and blocks the player made.
interpretation: Defensive activity - tackles plus interceptions plus blocks; high = a busy ball-winner (a volume read; also reflects how much the side has to defend)

description: Yellow and red cards the player received.
interpretation: Disciplinary record - yellow plus red cards; low = a clean record (a two-yellow dismissal counts as 3 because the provider logs a yellow plus a red)

description: Goals the player scored, penalties included and own goals not, per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: Scoring frequency; high = a prolific and dependable goalscorer.

description: Goals the player set up for a teammate per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: How often the player creates goals for others; high = a frequent creator.

description: The player's goals plus assists per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: Total goal involvement (goals + assists); high = drives the team's attacking output.

description: Shots on target the player had per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: How often the player tests the keeper; high = a persistent attacking threat.

description: The player's passes that led directly to a teammate's shot, per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: Shot-creating passes; high = a creative hub who makes chances.

description: Dribbles in which the player got past an opponent, per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: Take-ons completed; high = a dangerous ball-carrier who beats opponents.

description: Passes the player attempted per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: More passes played per 90 is better all else equal; volume also reads as role - high = a possession-anchoring role; low = a more direct one

description: Tackles the player made per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: More tackles per 90 is better all else equal; volume also reads as role - high = an aggressive ball-winner; can also reflect a side often defending

description: Opponents' passes the player intercepted per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: More interceptions per 90 is better all else equal; volume also reads as role - high = reads play and steps into passing lanes

description: Shots the player blocked per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: More blocks per 90 is better all else equal; volume also reads as role - high = throws the body in; often for a side under pressure

description: Tackles, interceptions and blocks the player made per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: More defensive actions (tackles + interceptions + blocks) per 90 is better all else equal; volume also reads as role - high = a deep block or an aggressive press

description: One-on-one challenges for the ball, on the ground or in the air, that the player won, per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: More duels won per 90 is better all else equal; this is a volume read - the duel win rate captures efficiency

description: Shots on target the player saved in goal per 90 minutes played.
interpretation: More saves per 90 is better all else equal; volume also tracks shots faced so it is not shot-stopping quality - the save rate captures that

description: Average per match of the team's shots on target minus its opponents' shots on target.
interpretation: On-target dominance - on-target shots created minus conceded per game; high = the process deserves results (deserved-vs-actual input)

description: Average number of shots on target the team's opponents had per match.
interpretation: On-target threat conceded - opponent shots on target per game; low = limits clear chances (deserved-vs-actual input)

description: The team's position in its league when the teams are ordered by deserved points, most first.
interpretation: Deserved league position - 1 = the most points the process deserved; where the process says the team should sit

description: Points the team would have won if its points per match followed its shots-on-target difference per match, as the two relate across its league season.
interpretation: Deserved points - what the season's on-target dominance was worth; compare it against the real points total

description: The points the team won in its played matches minus its deserved points.
interpretation: Deserved-vs-actual gap - actual minus deserved points; negative = results lag the process (due a correction), positive = results flatter it (regression risk). A narrative, not good or bad

description: The team's position in its league when the teams are ordered by deserved-points gap, the most negative first.
interpretation: Deserved-points gap position - 1 = the most under-rewarded team of the league, the last position the most over-rewarded; an ordering, not good or bad

description: The player's goals plus assists as a share of the goals the club scored on the pitch in that competition season.
interpretation: Share of the club's goals the player was involved in; high = central to the team's attack, but position-dependent (a defender's naturally-low share is not a negative). A style/role read, not good or bad.

description: Average minutes the player was on the pitch per match in which the player played.
interpretation: Average minutes per appearance; high = a full-90 regular, low = a rotation or impact-sub role. A playing-time role read, not good or bad.

description: Goals the team scored.
interpretation: Attacking output - goals scored; high = a potent attack (a raw count, so it rises with matches played; the per-match rate is the comparable read)

description: Goals the team conceded.
interpretation: Defensive vulnerability - goals conceded; low = a mean defence (a raw count, so a side that has played fewer matches shows a lower total without defending better; the per-match rate is the comparable read)

description: Corner kicks the team won.
interpretation: Corners won - high = sustained attacking pressure (a weak proxy for threat, and a raw count, so it rises with matches played)

description: Shots on target the team's goalkeepers saved.
interpretation: Shot-stopping volume - saves made; high = more shots kept out, which can reflect strong goalkeeping or a defence under sustained pressure

description: Shots the team took from inside the penalty area.
interpretation: Box shot volume - attempts taken from inside the area; high = more attempts from good positions (volume, not positional quality - shots_inside_box_pct is what measures that; a raw count, so it rises with matches played)

description: Matches in which the team conceded no goal.
interpretation: Shut-outs kept - matches conceding zero; high = reliable at the back (a raw count, so it rises with matches played)

description: Yellow cards the team's players received.
interpretation: Cautions - yellow cards collected over the season; low = disciplined, high = a side that fouls to stop play (a raw count, so it rises with matches played)

description: Red cards the team's players received.
interpretation: Dismissals - red cards collected over the season; low = keeps eleven on the pitch (rare enough that a single card dominates the count; a raw count, so it rises with matches played)

description: Average number of shots the team sent wide or over per match.
interpretation: Shots missing the target - attempts wide or over per game; high = gets shots away (volume; shooting accuracy says how many of them were on target)

description: Average number of the team's shots an opponent blocked per match.
interpretation: Shots blocked - attempts stopped by a defender before reaching goal; high = gets shots away into crowded areas (volume)

description: Average number of shots the team took from inside the penalty area per match.
interpretation: Box shot volume - attempts from inside the area per game; high = gets into good positions often (volume; shots_inside_box_pct is the share)

description: Average number of the team's passes that reached a teammate per match.
interpretation: Completed passing volume - passes that found a teammate per game; high = keeps and moves the ball (volume; pass accuracy is the share)

description: The team's passes as a share of all passes both teams played.
interpretation: Ball possession - share of the match's passes; high = controls the ball (control is not the same as chances)

description: Average number of times the team's players tried to dribble past an opponent per match.
interpretation: Take-ons attempted - dribbles tried per game; high = attacks players directly (volume; the completion share says how often it works)

description: Average number of dribbles in which the team's players got past an opponent per match.
interpretation: Take-ons completed - opponents beaten by dribbling per game; high = beats players often

description: The team's dribbles that got past an opponent, as a share of those attempted.
interpretation: Dribble success - share of take-ons completed; high = efficient at beating players

description: Average number of one-on-one challenges for the ball that the team's players won per match.
interpretation: Duels won - physical contests won per game; high = comes out on top in physical battles (volume; the win share captures efficiency)

description: Average number of shots on target the team's goalkeepers saved per match.
interpretation: Shot-stopping volume - saves per game; high = more shots kept out, which can reflect strong goalkeeping or a defence under sustained pressure

description: Average number of free kicks the team was awarded per match.
interpretation: Free kicks won - set-piece chances earned per game; high = draws fouls and wins dead-ball situations

description: Average number of fouls the team's players committed per match.
interpretation: Fouls committed - free kicks given away per game; low = disciplined (high can also mean a side that breaks up play on purpose)

description: Average number of times the team's players were caught offside per match.
interpretation: Offside calls - times caught beyond the last defender per game; low = better timed runs (high can reflect a side that plays on the shoulder)

description: Average number of yellow cards the team's players received per match.
interpretation: Cautions - yellow cards per game; low = disciplined, high = a side that fouls to stop play

description: Average number of red cards the team's players received per match.
interpretation: Dismissals - red cards per game; low = keeps eleven on the pitch (rare enough that a single card dominates a short window)
